grades.reason: This covers RISC-V vector float-to-integer conversions. It shows a vector destination operand vd with SEW-wide source and destination. It does not cover the scalar conversions or name the register file, so it only gives limited, indirect help.
The LoongArch FTINT pseudocode writes the integer result to FR[fd], the floating-point register file. That answers the LoongArch half of the question. The passage has no RISC-V content.

The RISC-V table lists rd as the destination register for FCVT.L.D and FCVT.LU.D. It does not say that rd is an integer register, and it uses rd for the int-to-float conversions too. It therefore gives only limited, partly implicit help.
